item.title: Tour de France Femmes: stage five, Mâcon to Belleville-en-Beaujolais – live
item.summary: Updates from 12:45 BST/13:45 CET Riders face checks for aerodynamic chest padding Email Luke | Sign up for The Recap “ I’m certain there will be hard attacks … hopefully not heart attacks … and we will try to follow.” (Marlen Reusser). “ It’s one of the steps to the main goal,” says Katarzyna Niewiadoma-Phinney of her individual time trial performance yesterday. “I know the real stuff is ahead of us. We’re definitely happy with the execution, but we keep our focus on upcoming stages. One day at a time.” Continue reading...
